1.en: By the fig and the olive

4.ar: لَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ فِىٓ أَحْسَنِ تَقْوِيمٍ
4.en: We have certainly created man in the best of stature;

5.en: Then We return him to the lowest of the low,

6.ar: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ فَلَهُمْ أَجْرٌ غَيْرُ مَمْنُونٍ
6.en: Except for those who believe and do righteous deeds, for they will have a reward uninterrupted.

7.en: So what yet causes you to deny the Recompense?

8.en: Is not Allah the most just of judges?
